integrity: Proof supplied through elementary finite-field quadratic Gauss sums, exact elliptic-cone incidence decomposition and a unitary-complement singular-value argument; q=2,3,4,5 independently checked by reproducible numerical computations.
scientific_limitations: Only Hermitian 2-by-2 matrices; complex linear sampling, not phaseless recovery; historical priority not exhaustively resolved. Numerical examples do not prove the infinite family.
title: Exact three-level singular spectrum of Fourier sampling on invertible Hermitian binary forms
